origin: Owner 2026-11-21 13:09 JST order「水分ボンバーオンラインもNARの資料もGoogleドライブの精読も接続しなさい」. The connection is applied to the formal ranking from the 2026-11-22 morning edition (EXT-CONNECTION v1.0). This registration fixes, before any connected race, how the connected ranking is checked against the base ranking it replaced.

owner_decision.owner_words: 水分ボンバーオンラインもNARの資料もGoogleドライブの精読も接続しなさい

change_under_test: EXT-CONNECTION v2.0 (see amendment): Full29 neutral slots filled + ranking overall' = 0.7 overall + 0.3 EXT; base = the Full29 ranking WITHOUT any external evidence is recorded per race for comparison only when computed (ranking_base = Full29 with evidence, before the EXT layer)

pre_evidence.nar_time_split: tables from NAR 2023-01..2026-06 (479,069 starts), tested on 2026-07..10 (49,183 starts, not used for the tables): top-3 A/E by EXT_NAR band <46 0.24 / 46-50 0.81 / 50-54 1.01 / 54-58 1.09; top-3 log-loss market 0.46823 -> market x EXT_NAR 0.46755 (final popularity, NAR components only, SBO/KB not in NAR)
pre_evidence.replay_20261120_36R: winner in W(top3): base 22 -> connected 25, W changed in 9 races (NAR+KB, no SBO cache; the day was seen before the weights were frozen, weights not tuned on it)

venue_rule: same direction in >= 2 venues with >= 12 races each

candidates.hypothesis: The connected ranking puts the winner in W (top 3) more often than the base Full29 ranking on the same races.
candidates.primary_metric: winner in W3 (connected vs base, same races); secondary: 2nd in P2 (top 6), all top-3 in P3 (top 9), winner mean rank, by venue
candidates.review_if: at 100 races connected winner-in-W3 is lower than base by >= 3 races, or lower in >= 2 venues with >= 12 races -> decision packet to the Owner (keep / reweight / disconnect). Nothing is reverted automatically.
